responsibility: Implements semantic analysis for D expressions. It performs compile-time string evaluation for pragma/mixin uses, resolves dot/template expressions and UFCS-sensitive member lookup, applies type merging and conversions, checks array ops, access control, escaping, nested references, and format-string builtins, and serves as the main expression elaboration stage that turns parsed expression ASTs into typed, semantically resolved forms consumed by optimization, CTFE, and lowering.
